tagline: A structured space for honest self-reflection.

ageGate.note: Configurable. Set the minimum age required to use the app.

telemetry.note: Telemetry is OFF and must remain opt-in and content-free if ever enabled. No user content may ever be transmitted.

patternDetection.note: If a pattern tag is logged >= recurrenceThreshold times within windowDays, the app gently surfaces it. Pure counting, no inference.

questionSelector.note: How many recently-shown questions to avoid repeating before they become eligible again.
